The epitope of  Fab 10E5 on integrin αIIbß3 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. Fab 10E5 binds solely to the αIIb cap subdomain and has no effect on its conformation. The peptide LGGAKQRGDV was soaked into crystals of the soluble headpiece of integrin αIIbβ3 (chain A: Integrin αIIb  chain B: Integrin β3) and the 10E5 Fab. Also, other structures were obtained by soaking other peptides, 2VDP, 2VDQ, 2VDO, 2VDN, and without peptides, 2VC2, 2VDK, 2VDL, 2VDM. Calculations show that the epitopes were identical in all structures; therefore, only one structure with the best resolution was curated.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.4 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 10E5 on integrin αIIbß3 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The crystals of the soluble headpiece of integrin αIIbβ3 (chain A: Integrin αIIb; chain B: Integrin β3) and the 10E5 Fab were soaked in buffer containing 2 mM Mn2+/0.1 mM Ca2+ for 4 h. There are two molecules in the asymmetric unit. The integrin αIIbβ3 is in the closed conformation (state 1). The next six intermediate βI conformations have been solved and are available in PDB in the sequence: (state 2) [PDB: 3ZDY], molecule 1; (state 3) [PDB: 3ZDZ], molecule 2; (state 4) [PDB: 3ZE0], molecule 2; (state 5) [PDB: 3ZE1] molecule 2; (state 6) [PDB: 3ZE2] molecule 1; (state 7) [PDB: 3ZDZ] molecule 1; and finally the fully open βI [PDB: 3ZE2] molecule 2; where molecule 1 refers to chains a & B of the integrin, and molecule 2, chains C & D. These eight states revealed a detailed pathway for headpiece opening: movements occur only in the β subunit, and from state 1 to 8, the Ser-123 backbone in the β1-α1 loop moves 2.2 Å, the ADMIDAS metal ion moves 3.9 Å, and the carbonyl oxygen of Met-335 moves 9.0 Å. In all structures, 10E5 Fab binds to the β-propeller domain of the αIIb subunit of the integrin, far from shape-shifting portions of the β subunit, and has no influence on β-propeller or integrin conformation.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.45 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 10E5 on integrin αIIbß3 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. Fab 10E5 binds solely to the αIIb subunit's ß-propeller domain. The crystals of soluble headpiece of integrin αIIbβ3 (chain A: Integrin αIIb chain B: Integrin β3) and the 10E5 Fab were soaked in buffer containing 5 mM Mg2+/1 mM Ca2+ and 10 mM peptide GRGDSP for 24 h. There are two molecules in the asymmetric unit. The integrin αIIbβ3 molecule 2 (chains C & D) is in the closed conformation (state 1) and the molecule 1 (chains A & B) is in an intermediate conformation (state 2) between closed and open states. The latter is curated here.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.45 angstroms

The epitope-specific 10E5 Fab binds solely to the αIIb cap subdomain and has no effect on its conformation. Binding of small molecules is not blocked by 10E5, as shown by their co-crystallization, and thus the mAb blocks binding to fibrinogen solely by occluding the macromolecular recognition site on the αIIb cap subdomain. The complex of the soluble headpiece of Integrin αIIbβ3 (Integrin αIIb - chain A, and Integrin β3 - chain B) and the 10E5 Fab was crystallized in the presence of cacodylate. Also, other  structures were obtained as tertiary complexes with drugs that antagonize  fibrinogen binding: tirofiban [PDB: 2VDM supersedes 1TY5], eptifibatide [PDB: 2VDN supersedes 1TY6], and Merck compound L-739758 [PDB: 2VC2 supersedes 1TY7], which do not differ substantially from this complex structure.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 10E5 on integrin αIIbß3 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The truncated fibrinogen γC AGDV peptide was soaked into αIIbβ3 headpiece crystals in the closed conformation (state 1) in 1 mM Mn2+ and 0.2 mM Ca2+. This trapped four distinct intermediate states during headpiece opening (open = state 8). Soaking times varied from 2 h [PDB: 4Z7O] to 1 week (this structure). Two copies of the αIIbβ3 headpiece complex (molecules 1 and 2) exist in one asymmetric unit, so two different conformational states existed in a single crystal.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.6 angstroms
